question: Who was the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnam Malleswari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Karnam Malleswari** is the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal. She achieved this historic feat during the **2000 Sydney Olympics**.

• She won the **bronze medal** in the sport of **weightlifting**, competing in the **69 kg category**.

• Her achievement marked a significant milestone for Indian sports, especially for women athletes, and inspired many young women to pursue sports in India.

• Born on **1 June 1975** in Andhra Pradesh, Karnam Malleswari started her weightlifting career at a young age and trained rigorously to reach the international level.

• She has also been honored with prestigious awards like the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna** in 1995 and the **Padma Shri** in 1999 for her contributions to Indian sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Mary Kom:** 

• Mary Kom is a renowned Indian boxer who has won multiple world championships and an Olympic bronze medal at the **2012 London Olympics**.

• She is a six-time world champion and widely regarded as one of the greatest boxers in the world.

• She belongs to Manipur and has been a strong advocate for women’s participation in sports.

• **Saina Nehwal:** 

• Saina Nehwal is an Indian badminton player who won a bronze medal at the **2012 London Olympics**.

• She was the first Indian badminton player to win an Olympic medal.

• Born in Haryana, she has won multiple international titles and inspired the growth of badminton in India.

• **P.V. Sindhu:** 

• P.V. Sindhu is an Indian badminton player who won a silver medal at the **2016 Rio Olympics** and a bronze medal at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.

• She is one of the most successful Indian athletes in badminton and has won several world championships.

• Sindhu hails from Andhra Pradesh and is a role model for aspiring athletes in India.

• **Significance of Olympic Achievements:** 

• The achievements of athletes like Karnam Malleswari, Mary Kom, Saina Nehwal, and P.V. Sindhu have played a crucial role in encouraging young Indian women to participate in sports.

• These milestones have also highlighted the need for better infrastructure and support for women in sports in India.

• The success of these athletes has brought international recognition to Indian sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Historical Context:** Karnam Malleswari’s bronze medal in the **2000 Sydney Olympics** was a turning point for Indian sports, as it was the first Olympic medal won by an Indian woman.

• **Recognition and Awards:** Her achievements earned her prestigious awards like the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna** and **Padma Shri**, recognizing her contribution to Indian sports.

• **Inspiration:** Karnam Malleswari’s success inspired a generation of Indian women athletes and increased awareness about women’s sports in India.

• **Legacy:** Her achievement remains a landmark event in the history of Indian sports, emphasizing the potential of Indian women in the global sports arena.
